title: eschweilera verruculosa
intro: Eschweilera verruculosa, commonly known as the "Gumbo-Limbo," is a species of flowering plant in the family Lecythidaceae. It is known for its medicinal properties, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can contribute to the prevention and treatment of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Eschweilera verruculosa include its ability to exhibit antimicrobial and antiparasitic properties, which can be beneficial in treating infections and other health issues. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
